properties.summary: The trials' small faults 1–15 (stated foundations not unsupported; generated step names follow premises; source text noted; one answer from several records; reasoning_report spends and names its budget; self-asked questions withdrawn by id; silent_on; session counts say when uncounted; kept calc records are executable and fed back; setpoint and source on constraints; foundations-and-proof note; a check's walk never crosses GOVERNED_BY; a settled decision's own PROPOSED text caught), the hub's name-prefix fault, one formula as one record per occurrence (same_formula_as, read-back `formulas`), and what rests on an undocumented report reads conditional on it.
